description: AI-powered business card scanner that captures images and extracts contact information automatically using Google's Gemini AI. This tool streamlines the process of adding new contacts by digitizing business cards.

pages.name: BusinessCardScannerComponent
pages.description: This component provides an interface for capturing or uploading business card images and using AI to automatically extract contact details. It's designed to quickly add new contacts to your system by digitizing physical business cards.

buttons.label: Toggle Camera
buttons.description: Switches between the front and back camera on mobile devices. This helps you find the best angle and lighting for capturing the business card clearly.
when_to_use: When the current camera view isn't optimal for capturing the business card clearly.
If you need to switch from a selfie camera to the main camera or vice-versa.

buttons.label: Capture
buttons.description: Takes a photo of the business card using the active camera. This image will then be processed by the AI for information extraction.
when_to_use: When you have positioned the business card within the on-screen frame and are ready to take a photo for scanning.

buttons.label: Scan
buttons.description: Initiates the AI processing of the captured or uploaded business card image to automatically extract contact information such as name, company, phone, email, and address.
when_to_use: After capturing or uploading a business card image and you want to automatically extract contact details.

buttons.label: Retake
buttons.description: Clears the currently captured image and reactivates the camera, allowing you to take a new photo of the business card.
when_to_use: When the previously captured image quality is poor (e.g., blurry, bad lighting).
If the business card wasn't positioned correctly within the frame in the previous attempt.

buttons.label: Upload Image
buttons.description: Allows you to select and upload an existing image of a business card from your device's storage for AI processing, instead of taking a new photo.
when_to_use: When you already have a photo of a business card saved on your device and prefer to use that instead of capturing a new one.
If your device's camera is not working or you prefer to use a higher quality image from another source.

help_guidance.when_stuck: If you're having trouble, ensure the business card is placed on a flat surface with good, even lighting. Position the card within the on-screen overlay frame. You have two options: either capture a new photo using your device's camera or upload an existing image from your gallery. Once an image is available, click 'Scan' to let the AI automatically extract the contact details.
common_tasks: Scanning a business card: Place the card within the camera's frame, click 'Capture', then click 'Scan' to process the image with AI.
Using an existing image: Click 'Upload Image', then select a photo of a business card from your device's gallery.
Improving scan quality: If the captured image is unclear or misaligned, click 'Retake' to try capturing the photo again.
Switching cameras: On mobile devices, use the 'Toggle Camera' button to switch between front and back cameras for optimal capture.
Extracting data: After successfully capturing or uploading an image, click the 'Scan' button to initiate the AI-powered data extraction.
help_guidance.getting_started: To get started, ensure you have a physical business card ready. Open the Business Card Scanner. You can either use your device's camera to 'Capture' a new image of the card, or if you already have a photo, click 'Upload Image' to select it from your device. Once the image is loaded, click 'Scan' to let the AI extract the contact information.
